name: argon-tool-result-appendix
description: Projects host-generated automatic reminders immediately following a complete tool batch into the last tool_result appendix for explicitly configured Argon models.

interface.shortDescription: Pack contiguous host auto-injections into the last tool_result appendix for selected Argon models.
interface.longDescription: Keeps canonical contextMemory and wire records untouched while projecting verified host auto-injections immediately following a complete, unique tool call batch into the final tool_result block as an explicitly tagged appendix text part.

strategy.title: Projection Strategy
strategy.description: Choose whether host auto-injections after a complete tool batch are sent as-is (passthrough) or appended to the final tool_result block (tool_result_appendix).

zh-CN.title: 发送投影策略
zh-CN.description: 选择同批工具完成后的自动宿主注入是原样发送（passthrough），还是并入最后一个 tool_result 的独立标识附录（tool_result_appendix）。

targetModels.title: Target Models
targetModels.description: Comma, semicolon, or newline separated model aliases or IDs that opt into tool_result appendix projection.

zh-CN.title: 启用模型列表
zh-CN.description: 使用逗号、分号或换行分隔的目标模型别名或模型 ID（仅明确列出的模型会启用工具结果附录投影）。
